props.name: remember
props.description: Initial state of the "remember me" checkbox.

props.name: error
props.description: Show the credentials error and mark both fields invalid.

props.name: loading
props.description: Submission in progress: the submit button is disabled and shows a spinner.

props.name: providers
props.description: Social sign-in buttons, in order; `[]` hides them and the divider.

props.name: labels
props.description: UI copy; every key is optional and falls back to the English default.

props.name: animated
props.description: Play the entrance animation (default false). When false, render the final state.

props.name: fill
props.description:
Make the visual fill the box it is given instead of sitting in the gallery preview frame: drops the frame's side padding, stretches on the cross axis and removes the module's `max-w-*` cap. Off by default, so the preview rendering — and every golden — is unchanged.

Turn it on to use a visual as a panel in an app layout, where a centred, capped card gives mismatched widths and edges from one cell to the next.
